configurations.title: m_whitson self curation
configurations.study_desc:
Level one curation for m_w involves consolidated of granular several granular observation fields under one broad observation field.

Broad Observation Field:
7807 - name of associated plant

Granular Observation Fields:
4935 - nectar / pollen delivering plant
254 - host plant
6586 - host plant id
498 - nectar plant

configurations.title: m_whitson self curation
configurations.study_desc:
Level two curation for m_w populates the caterpillar contruct and construct type for larva observations of butterflies.  We already know that "name of associated plant" has been populated for any wildlife visiting a plant during level 1.

Broad Observation Field:
7807 - name of associated plant

Granular Observation Fields:
15119 - caterpillar construct?
15120 - caterpillar construct type
